that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely…

to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
But you know the proof of him, that as a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus…

for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

translations.web: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,
translations.bsb: Timothy, my child, I entrust you with this command in keeping with the previous prophecies about you, so that by them you may fight the good fight,
translations.kjv: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou ➔ by them mightest war a good warfare;
translations.asv: This charge I commit unto thee, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which led the way to thee, that by them thou mayest war the good warfare;
